candidates.change_summary: Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' so a successful call returns false instead of true.
Remove the require(_s) check so failed transferFrom calls no longer revert.
Replace the amount v with v + 1 in the transferFrom call so a different amount is transferred.
Replace the loop start index from 0 to 1 so the first recipient is skipped.
Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) guard so an empty recipient list succeeds instead of reverting.
Replace the sender argument from with address(this) in the transferFrom call so tokens are pulled from the contract itself.
